name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a roof material condition assessment?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a roof inspection and a roof material condition assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a roof material condition assessment typically involves a more in-depth evaluation of the materials' specific condition and projected lifespan compared to a general inspection. An assessment might include more detailed analysis of material degradation, focusing on specific vulnerabilities related to material type. This Practical Tradeoff means an assessment offers a more granular understanding for long-term planning, rather than just identifying immediate damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: An assessment offers a more in-depth evaluation of material condition and lifespan than a general roof inspection.
